tweakswitch.title: TweakSwitch
tweakswitch.incompatible: Made for a different Minecraft version; it may not work correctly.
tweakswitch.importFailed: Some packs could not be imported. Check the log for details.
tweakswitch.vt.title: Vanilla Tweaks Packs (%s)
tweakswitch.vt.selectShown.tooltip: Selects every pack in the list below (use search to narrow it down). Click again to clear them.
tweakswitch.doneHint: Go back to TweakSwitch to switch them on.
tweakswitch.doneHintOn: They're switched on. Click Done in TweakSwitch to apply.
tweakswitch.switchOn.tooltip: On: packs you download come back switched on, and Done on the TweakSwitch screen applies them. Off: they come back off for you to choose.
tweakswitch.someFailed: %s failed. Check the log for details.
tweakswitch.mr.title: Modrinth Resource Packs (%s)
tweakswitch.getVanillaTweaks.tooltip: Pick Vanilla Tweaks packs and download each one as its own switch.
tweakswitch.getModrinth.tooltip: Search Modrinth's resource packs for this version and download them as switches.
tweakswitch.mr.needsPacks: Also downloads the packs it needs: %s
tweakswitch.dp.button.tooltip: Add Vanilla Tweaks data packs and crafting tweaks to this world. They change gameplay, not textures, so they live here instead of with your resource packs.
tweakswitch.dp.title: Vanilla Tweaks Data Packs
tweakswitch.dp.doneHint: They switch on for this world when you click Done.
tweakswitch.mods.title: ⚠ Some packs need mods
tweakswitch.mods.explain: These packs need mods you don't have. Download Mods puts their Fabric versions in your mods folder for you, or click a mod to open its page.
tweakswitch.mods.install.tooltip: Downloads these mods (and any mods they need) from Modrinth into your mods folder, then the packs. The mods work once you restart Minecraft.
tweakswitch.mods.downloadAnyway.tooltip: Downloads just the packs. They may look wrong until you add the mods.
tweakswitch.mods.installed.title: ✔ Mods downloaded
tweakswitch.mods.installed.failed: No Fabric version for this Minecraft version on Modrinth. Open its page to look:
tweakswitch.mods.restart: ⟳ The mods will work once you restart Minecraft.
tweakswitch.mods.continue.tooltip: Downloads the packs. Restart Minecraft afterwards so the mods load.
tweakswitch.getUpdates.tooltip: Check your downloaded packs for newer versions.
tweakswitch.updates.title: Pack Updates
tweakswitch.updates.none: No packs in the TweakSwitch folder yet.
tweakswitch.updates.detail.vanillaTweaks: Vanilla Tweaks packs don't have version numbers. Pick it to download it again and get any changes since you downloaded it.
tweakswitch.updates.detail.noVersion: Installed: %s. Modrinth has no version of this pack for Minecraft %s.
tweakswitch.updates.detail.unknown: This file isn't on Modrinth or Vanilla Tweaks, so it can't be checked for updates.
tweakswitch.group.name: A–Z
tweakswitch.empty.imported: No imported packs. Drop resource pack .zip files on this screen, or put them in the folder with Open Folder.
tweakswitch.empty.vanillaTweaks: No Vanilla Tweaks packs yet. Click + Vanilla Tweaks below to pick some.
tweakswitch.empty.modrinth: No Modrinth packs yet. Click + Modrinth below to search for some.
